**Summary**

This PR changes how the locale is removed from the URL during navigation. There was previously an edge case where part of the path would be incorrectly removed, being wrongly detected as the locale. The regular expression is now stricter to only match the appropriate part of the URL.

CR-5454 → FX-2769
